citations.title: Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism Standard (ML-KEM)
citations.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
citations.relevance_to_prime: Finalized primary PQC standard for quantum-resistant key establishment and general key encapsulation.

citations.title: Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature Standard (ML-DSA)
citations.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
citations.relevance_to_prime: Finalized primary PQC standard for digital signatures and authentication replacements for RSA/ECDSA.

citations.title: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard (SLH-DSA)
citations.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
citations.relevance_to_prime: Finalized hash-based digital signature standard providing an alternative mathematical foundation not relying on lattice hardness.

citations.title: Considerations for Quantum-Ready and Post-Quantum Cryptographic Migration and Agility

citations.relevance_to_prime: Provides formal mathematical definitions for coupling dimensions C1-C5 and migration dimensions E1-E2 utilized in PRIME.

citations.relevance_to_prime: Informs PRIME's source code static taint and call-site recognition engine for Node.js/TypeScript environments.

citations.title: Post-Quantum and Traditional Hybrid Key Encapsulation in TLS 1.3
citations.relevance_to_prime: Defines X25519MLKEM768 and SecP256r1MLKEM768 hybrid key exchange mechanisms for TLS migration.
